info.title: CRM Price Books Crm Reads Api

put.description: Create the default association type between two specified object types in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to establish a generic association between two objects, identified by their types and IDs. It is useful for linking related records within the CRM system.

parameters.name: fromObjectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the source object for the association.

parameters.name: fromObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the source object for the association.

parameters.name: toObjectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the target object for the association.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the target object for the association.

get.description: Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying desired properties, associations, and whether to include archived objects. This endpoint is useful for fetching objects with specific properties and their historical values, as well as associated object IDs.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object to retrieve.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for obtaining multiple objects in a single request, which can help optimize data retrieval processes in applications that need to handle large datasets. The response includes the objects' details, and you can specify whether to include archived objects.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object to retrieve, such as contacts or deals.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

post.description: Search for CRM objects of a specified type using the provided criteria. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort objects based on various properties, and retrieve a collection of objects matching the search criteria. It is useful for finding specific records or analyzing data trends within your CRM.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of CRM object to search, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

get.description: Read an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object to read.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to read.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object type and object ID, with a limit of 500 results per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between different CRM objects.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object for which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the object for which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated objects to retrieve.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field to retrieve the next set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. Defaults to 500.

put.description: Set association labels between two records in the CRM. This endpoint allows you to define specific labels for the association between two objects identified by their types and IDs. It is useful for categorizing or labeling relationships between different CRM objects.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the first object in the association.

parameters.name: objectType
parameters.description: The type of the first object in the association.

parameters.name: toObjectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the second object in the association.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the second object in the association.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

id.description: The unique identifier for the association. It is a string.

type.description: The type of the association. It is a string.

AssociatedId.description: Contains the id and type of an association

associationCategory.description: A string representing the category of the association. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

associationTypeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

AssociationSpec.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

propertiesWithHistory.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.
